_about: A page's containers pre-processed into the samples its cursors read (tools/page_samples.py; journal 243). kind original = no file: the sound as it is. A place p (s) in a container is, in its render: p - t0 for an override (it keeps the container's length); (p - t0) / speed for an icy; with a speed [from, to], lasts * ln(1 + f (r - 1)) / ln r, f = (p - t0) / (t1 - t0), r = to / from.
